isolation.cleanup: read-only stage inputs are re-hashed after exit, the stage is removed, and removal is verified before the next execution
isolation.fail_closed: any namespace, sandbox, meter, staging or cleanup failure stops the run and invalidates the epoch

filesystem_sandbox.limits: fs_sandbox.c rlimits: 4 GiB address space, 600 CPU seconds, 512 MiB per file, 1024 open files, 256 processes, no core files

isolation.meter: per-execution cgroup-v1 memory and pids groups hold the whole process tree; memory.limit_in_bytes and pids.max enforce the ceilings; memory.max_usage_in_bytes is the peak; a missing, unreadable or zero measurement fails the epoch
isolation.output: launcher stops reading and kills the process group once stdout plus stderr exceed 256 MiB
isolation.temp_storage: total bytes under STAGE/tmp after exit, the only writable tree
isolation.wall_clock: launcher kills the process group at 900 seconds

environment_manifest.working_directory: fresh per-execution stage root; its absolute path is diagnostic

distinguishing_rule.context: The card showed the candidate each rule was predicted to select, and a local dry run with this rule had already reproduced those measures and recommend_st_rel. The choice was made before this suite's first epoch was prepared, not before its outcome could be known.

provenance.note: diagnostic only; the epoch identity is content-addressed
